t: PLSE Seminar Series: Emery Berger, "Saving the World from Spreadsheets"

q.x: One of the interesting takeaways from Emery Berger's talk, is that he was able to replicate to 2 decimal places a published spreadsheet transcription error rate of 5.26% of cells have errors. I highly recommend the talk. [link]
